about.label: About me
about.title: Fadholi
about.bio1: I'm a full-stack engineer with a deep focus on the frontend. I care about performance, design systems, and the small details that make products feel delightful.
about.bio2: I'm particularly passionate about performance engineering, design systems, and building interfaces that feel native and fast. I believe the best products are the ones where you don't notice the engineering — everything just works.
about.bio3: Outside of code, I enjoy photography, jogging, skiing, reading technical documentations and contributing to open-source projects when time allows.

timeline.description: Working on software development at Money Forward, a leading Japanese fintech company. Stack: Next.js, React, Kotlin, TypeScript, AWS, Datadog, Rollbar, CircleCI.

Developed discussion features, Google SSO, notification system, pinned topics, and user profiles. Set up automated deployment via GitHub Actions and AWS App Runner, and integrated CI unit testing on pull requests. Stack: Next.js, React, Python, AWS App Runner, Sentry.

Frontend engineer on Indonesia's largest e-commerce platform. Built and maintained seller-facing apps (Promo, Campaign, Tax, Thematic, Voucher) using React and Apollo GraphQL. Handled PWA deployment to Microsoft Store and built internal productivity & monitoring tools (New Relic, Grafana, Scalyr).
Built an e-learning platform from scratch with Nuxt.js, integrating Midtrans for payments and FlowPlayer for video playback.

Led the frontend team, translating business requirements into technical tasks. Developed multiple products (Jojoflow, Jojoexpense, Jojopayroll, Jojosales) and an on-premise Costcenter app using Vue.js.
Migrated the tech stack from jQuery to Vue.js. Initiated a component library published to npm and introduced micro frontend architecture across the apps.
Revamped the landing page and built a recruitment dashboard using Vue.js.
Research under the P3MI-ITB program on shoot multiplication and growth rates in temporary immersion bioreactors.

projects.label: Selected work

portfolio-2026.title: Portfolio 2026
portfolio-2026.description: A minimal, multi-themed personal portfolio built with Next.js, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, and Framer Motion. Features five color themes and smooth page transitions.

ja-learning.title: JA Learning
ja-learning.description: A Japanese language learning platform for intermediate learners. Features structured lessons across 11 chapters, 1,400+ vocabulary words, kanji instruction, quizzes, and audio pronunciation guides.

transfr.title: Transfr
transfr.description: A web app that enables seamless transfer of digital wallet balances between popular Indonesian e-wallet platforms including OVO, Dana, GoPay, and LinkAja.

desa-wisata.title: Desa Wisata
desa-wisata.description: A tourism destination web platform showcasing local Indonesian villages as travel destinations, helping travelers discover and explore rural tourism spots.

supabase-auth-app.title: Supabase Auth App
supabase-auth-app.description: A full-stack authentication starter app built with Supabase, featuring secure login, session management, and a clean, minimal UI.
